title: Pin and verify uv in install-python.ps1
goal: install-python.ps1 downloads the pinned uv Windows archive for the machine's architecture from the official release, checks its SHA-256 against the pin, puts uv.exe in the user's folder on the user PATH, and treats another uv on PATH or one it would replace as a CONFLICT; the test covers the uv pin and a planted uv conflict; kb-setup step 1 and maintaining.md install uv this way on Windows instead of pip.
